scripts.lint: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone,packages "npm run lint --workspace frontend" "npm run lint --workspace desktop" "npm run lint --workspace phone" "npm run lint:packages"
scripts.lint:frontend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone "npm run lint --workspace frontend" "npm run lint --workspace desktop" "npm run lint --workspace phone"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone,packages "npm run typecheck --workspace frontend" "npm run typecheck --workspace desktop" "npm run typecheck --workspace phone" "npm run typecheck:packages"
scripts.typecheck:frontend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone "npm run typecheck --workspace frontend" "npm run typecheck --workspace desktop" "npm run typecheck --workspace phone"
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint:frontend && npm run typecheck:frontend
